title: Talking to colleague feels like one teammate: the front model (senses) answers you first — in its own words, instantly — and only wakes cortex for real repo work, visibly handing off; greetings and 'what/how are you' get a self-aware reply from the front door, not a vague cortex detour that spawns a branch and a memory record.

claims.text: Talking to colleague feels like one teammate: the front model (senses) answers you first — in its own words, instantly — and only wakes cortex for real repo work, visibly handing off; greetings and 'what/how are you' get a self-aware reply from the front door, not a vague cortex detour that spawns a branch and a memory record.

honesty_conditions.text: In a real armed session, the operator's FIRST response to 'hi' comes from senses (the front model), not cortex, and that turn creates NO git branch and NO eidetic record

claims.text: the operator driving 'colleague session' interactively at the prompt (a human typing free text), and — by the presence-default-everywhere all-fronts rule — anyone conversing with a colleague resident/talk surface where senses fronts cortex

honesty_conditions.text: The change is felt on BOTH the interactive session prompt and the resident/talk fronts (all-fronts presence rule), not a single surface

claims.text: senses answers FIRST in its own words; a social/greeting turn ('hi') and a question about colleague itself ('what model are you', 'how do you work') are answered by senses directly with NO cortex work item — no branch, no eidetic record; a real repo task gets a senses ack, then a visibly-labeled cortex-is-working indicator, then cortex's result presented conversationally; senses' self-answers are grounded in a real colleague-architecture fact-set

every free-text line is classify_intent->work->a full cortex work item: 'hi' spawns colleague/<id>-hi + a memory record, and 'what model are you?' is answered by cortex (vaguely: 'no visibility into which backend'); the front model, if armed, only rides as a one-line intake-ack + a concurrent narrator layered on top of a cortex dispatch that ALWAYS happens — so the operator cannot tell a distinct, faster front mind is even involved

honesty_conditions.text: The pain is real today: a bare 'hi' in a live armed session currently produces a colleague/<id>-hi branch AND an eidetic record — reproducible before the change

claims.text: the two-model split (fast wide front + strong back) only pays off if the operator FEELS one coherent, responsive teammate; otherwise it is just cortex plus extra latency, and burning a full work item (git branch + memory write) on 'hi' is both slow and litters the repo/store

honesty_conditions.text: With senses-direct, a non-repo turn's latency is the fast front model's alone (no cortex round-trip), measurably quicker than routing through cortex

claims.text: NOT a general task->model routing policy: senses does not learn or freely decide arbitrary routing; the senses-direct surface is FIXED + enumerated (social turns + colleague-self-description, expressed only through senses' EXISTING reply_to_operator/clarify moves — no new capability, no repo tool reachable). Any request that would TOUCH THE REPO (read or write) ALWAYS dispatches to cortex. Cortex stays the ONLY mind that acts on the repo. Not changing plan/explore/review verbs; not a new GUI

in a live session: 'hi' returns an instant senses reply and creates NO branch and NO eidetic record; 'what model are you / how do you work' returns a correct colleague-architecture-grounded answer from senses with no cortex dispatch; a real task shows senses-ack -> a distinct labeled cortex-working indicator -> cortex result; and every operator-facing line is unmistakably attributable to senses vs cortex

honesty_conditions.text: Every success signal is observable by an operator in one live session at the prompt / in the artifact, without reading code

claims.text: Ack-first ordering: when senses is armed, senses perceives the operator's line and its acknowledgment is the FIRST operator-facing output for that turn — before any mechanical routing/dispatch line; a cortex-only / unarmed session stays byte-identical (no ack, same output as today)

honesty_conditions.text: The senses ack renders before the mechanical routing/dispatch line on every armed front (session/talk/resident); a cortex-only or unarmed run emits no ack and is byte-identical to today's output — test-pinned

claims.text: Enumerated senses-direct surface: senses may CONCLUDE a turn without cortex ONLY through its already-enumerated coordination moves (reply_to_operator / clarify) — no new answer capability, no repo tool reachable from senses — and only for the fixed class {social/greeting turns, questions about colleague itself}; any turn that would read or write the repo provably still dispatches to cortex

honesty_conditions.text: Senses concluding a turn without cortex happens ONLY via reply_to_operator/clarify, and a repo-touching request (e.g. 'fix the bug in X' or 'what does file Y do') provably STILL dispatches to cortex; senses has no reachable repo tool (existing structural pin holds)

claims.text: Grounded self-knowledge: senses answers 'what/how are you' from a CURATED colleague architecture/identity fact-set and defers ('I don't know / cortex can check') beyond it; a fabricated architecture claim is a test failure, mirroring the existing grounded-narration honesty rail

honesty_conditions.text: Senses' self-answer draws only on the curated architecture fact-set; asked something outside it, senses defers to cortex rather than inventing, and a fabricated architecture claim is a test failure

claims.text: Visible hand-off: on a real dispatch the operator sees a distinct, labeled indicator that cortex (the back model) is now working, visually separable from senses' own lines; the senses-vs-cortex attribution is reconstructable from TaskResult.senses in the artifact

honesty_conditions.text: An operator can tell at a glance which line is senses vs cortex-working, and both the attribution and the senses-direct-vs-dispatch decision are recorded on TaskResult.senses so the turn is reconstructable from the artifact alone

claims.text: Land this as the FIFTH sanctioned router-exclusion increment via re-spec: senses-direct (#276) becomes a fixed, enumerated, repo-untouching surface rather than a general routing policy — documented with the #276 relationship stated explicitly (closes or re-scopes #276)

honesty_conditions.text: The shipped spec/docs state the FIXED enumerated senses-direct surface + the repo-untouching invariant and reconcile #276 explicitly — it is provably not a learned/general task->model router

hard_questions.text: Does the user sanction landing #276 (senses answers some turns without cortex) as a fifth fixed/enumerated router-exclusion increment — or must senses ALWAYS dispatch (keeping #276 parked), making this spec only ack-first + visible-handoff + architecture-informed-context-to-cortex?

claims.text: Senses actually ARMS in the operator's live setup — the lobes gateway resolves gemma4 as the senses role and qwen as cortex and the senses endpoint is reachable (cf. the known lobes dead-endpoint workaround); if senses does not arm, that is a config prerequisite, out of scope for this behavior spec

honesty_conditions.text: If senses fails to arm, the session degrades to today's cortex-only behavior with a diagnosable notice, never a hard failure

claims.text: senses answers FIRST in its own words; ANY non-repo turn — greetings/social, questions about colleague itself, and general conversation/advice needing no repo access — is answered by senses directly with NO cortex work item (no branch, no eidetic record); the moment a turn needs to read/write the repo, run a command, or produce a work artifact, it gets a senses ack, then a distinct labeled cortex-is-working indicator, then cortex's result presented conversationally; senses' self-answers are grounded in a real colleague-architecture fact-set

honesty_conditions.text: Given the repo-touching invariant, the senses-direct-vs-cortex split is deterministic — the same input yields the same routing every run, no per-input drift

claims.text: NOT a general task->model routing policy. Bright-line invariant: any turn that TOUCHES THE REPO (reads/writes files, runs a command, produces a work artifact) ALWAYS dispatches to cortex — cortex stays the ONLY mind that acts on the repo. Senses-direct is the NON-REPO complement, expressed ONLY through senses' EXISTING reply_to_operator/clarify moves (no new capability, no repo tool reachable). Not changing plan/explore/review verbs; not a new GUI

honesty_conditions.text: A reviewer can point to the fixed enumerated surface + repo-touching invariant in the shipped spec/docs and confirm it is not a learned/general router

claims.text: Enumerated senses-direct surface: senses may CONCLUDE a turn without cortex ONLY via reply_to_operator/clarify, and ONLY for non-repo turns (social, about-colleague, general non-repo conversation); a turn that would read/write the repo, run a command, or produce a work artifact provably STILL dispatches to cortex, and senses has no reachable repo tool

honesty_conditions.text: A repo-touching request (reads/writes files, runs a command, or produces a work artifact) provably STILL dispatches to cortex — test-pinned; senses concludes a turn without cortex ONLY via reply_to_operator/clarify and has no reachable repo tool (existing structural pin holds)

claims.text: Attribution style: senses lines carry a 'senses:' prefix and cortex operation shows a 'cortex ▸ working…' status line, with distinct colours on a colour TTY (senses one hue, cortex another); off a colour TTY it degrades to plain labels — machine-parseable stdout preserved, presence rides stderr, --json unaffected

open_vagueness.text: Trigger mechanism for senses-direct: senses' own loop judgment (reply_to_operator vs dispatch_to_cortex — the move surface already supports this) versus a deterministic pre-classifier gating what senses may self-answer
Whether suppressing the branch + eidetic record for a senses-answered turn falls out automatically (no cortex dispatch = no handoff) or needs an explicit work-path guard
Where the curated colleague-architecture fact-set lives and how it stays current (a dedicated doc/prompt fragment vs derived from CLAUDE.md/docs) — drift risk
